## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Ran `npm test` and all 46+ tests pass.
- [ ] Ran `npm run lint` (`tsc --noEmit`) and there are 0 errors.
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` and production bundle built successfully.
- [ ] Tested responsive design on both mobile (iPhone & Android) and desktop views.
- [ ] If user-facing strings were added, translations were provided across all 5 languages (`en`, `fr`, `es`, `zh`, `de`).
- [ ] Verified that no secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] Preserved existing user data and LocalStorage schema backwards-compatibility.
